title: Office After Hours [Playtest fixes 3]
description: 10 offices. Touch blue door buttons and drawer handles. Hold physical gems for immunity; release to lose protection. 60s calm / 60s hunt; key after five hunts. All dead: 5-second countdown and new round in the hall. Experimental: Quest validation required.

AFTER HOURS
SURVIVE FIVE HUNTS — 10 PLAYERS

Touch blue door buttons and drawer handles.
Touch blue pads to hide / leave. One player per spot.
HOLD a gem for immunity. Dropping it removes protection.
After five hunts: find the key and touch the exit lock.
DEAD players watch from the enclosed balcony.
